text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hmm… What an unexpected result. I guess I should have expected no less from the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The stronger my opponents are, the stronger I'll become, just as a pearl grows larger over time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In other words, today's narrow defeat has served to expand my possibilities even more!
choice_data_list: Can I take you at your word on that?
Can I take you at your word on that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha… thanks. But I've got my sights set on the world stage, so I can't allow myself to be held to such lenient standards.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And to even further elevate my pursuit, we have to get out there and train! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Of course! Just sit back, relax, and leave everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Stand directly by my side so you can bear witness to the moment I rewrite history!
